shape: 3-leg FULL JOIN (wd / d / ad) over Sales_Ledger__dlm; outer scope applies CDPMONTH(HOUR_ADD(...)) date logic in GROUP BY
scopeNotes: co appears in all three legs; sap only in wd and d. Alias-reuse trap: each co/sap must scope to its owning leg. The invariant test enforces every co/sap parent is a leg (wd/d/ad), never __root__.

externalId.comment: No *ExternalId* output column. Rollup CI; grain from the outer GROUP BY.

regressionAnchors.why: anti-join in the wd leg: LEFT OUTER JOIN Region_Assignment__dlm then WHERE Region_Assignment__dlm.Common_Owner__c IS NULL. Drop is at the wd-scope WHERE, not the join.

dateLogicComment: Outer TxMonth__c = CDPMONTH(HOUR_ADD(IFNULL(IFNULL(wd.TxDate__c, d.TxDate__c), ad.TxDate__c), 0)) — outer-scope date derivation over the coalesced leg dates.

findings.hardcodedIdComment: '012000000000001AAA' Business Account RecordTypeId__c literal, repeated across legs
